newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index slightly higher.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index was 1.47 points or 2.22 percent higher at 67.59 after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index rose 35.44 points to a provisional 3001.10 close.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 14.19 percent after 12.94 percent on Friday.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
